notes.title: Update 12/15/2023
notes.content: Added full screen support.  Can enable this by going into Settings and checking the option on.  Can be turned off the same way.

tags.feature: - Added full screen support. Can enable this by going into Settings and checking the option on. Can be turned off the same way.

notes.title: Update 11/5/2023
notes.content: Small update to the Leaderboard size.

tags.bug: - Fixed an empty item panel sometimes showing on the scoreboard.
-DE_Library: Fixed bug where some clients would crash on bomb explosion.
- Fixed a bug where removing/adding a silencer would also drop a magazine on the ground.

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

tags.balance_change: * Eul's Scepter of Divinity: Bonus movement speed reduced from +40 to +30
